frozen.stage_a: Q = P0 + kappa_* + 0.25 (a + ib), a, b = -3..4 (64); groups (kind, L, direction) (chord2, 0.3, radial), (arc, 0.3, radial), (chord2, 0.3, horizontal), (chord2, 0.6, horizontal), near-end exponent 4; alpha 0 or beta - 1; eta 1e-6..10 in half decades (15, amended from 13 up to 1); phi 0, 90, 180, 270; 30720 plants at wf 1.00, in the order a, b, group, alpha, eta, phi; stops after 4 h and lists what it did not reach
frozen.stage_b: from the 8 best admissible stage-A starts by d_P at wf 1.00, one per (kind, a, b, group, alpha), Nelder-Mead on (log10 eta, phi, Re o, Im o, L, theta) with D3 = the largest d_P over the three nodes (1 + the largest fit_resid if a node is inadmissible, 10 if a Pade fails); simplex steps (0.5, 45, 0.06, 0.06, 0.08, 20), bounds log10 eta [-6, 1] (amended from 0), Re o and Im o [-1, 1.25], L [0.05, 1.2]; 200 evaluations, xatol 1e-3, fatol 1e-5; theta absolute (radial start: arg Q at wf 1.00)
frozen.stage_c: every admissible stage-A plant with d_P <= 0.06 at wf 1.00 (the 300 smallest) at wf 0.99 and 1.01
frozen.passes: admissible and d_P <= 0.03 at the three nodes, same parameters; the answer is yes if any plant of stages A to C passes, no otherwise; every plant with d_P <= 0.03 at a node is rechecked through pade_second_set.pade_record, and a disagreement exits 1
frozen.located: #718's rule on the 64 positions; a passing position with four lattice neighbours inside the lattice that fail is a candidate; diagonal points are not run
frozen.R1: the poles-only d_P and nearest poles equal pade_record's bit for bit, 6 plants at wf 1.00; --mutate=prec (12 digits) fails it
frozen.R2: radial curves equal ring_curve's bit for bit at 64 positions and L 0.3, 0.6; horizontal A = Q - L exactly; exact moments of a horizontal and a theta = 30 deg segment against mpmath.quad within 1e-40; --mutate=dir fails it
frozen.R3: point masses' moments equal the mean of the tiny-segment limits (L = 1e-30, P 0, alpha 0) at k = 0, 7, 15, 22, 31 within 1e-20 relative; --mutate=pole_w fails it
frozen.R4: 12 of #718's plants (first record at wf 1.00 of I718-mac/ring.jsonl for (chord2, arc) x L 0.3 radial positions (+1, +1), (0, 0), (-1, -1) x alpha 0, beta - 1) through this path: d_P within 1e-6 relative; control --mutate=len (L x 1.01) fails it
frozen.J: J+ the real series' d_P <= 1e-9 at every node; J- the eta = 0 chord2 and arc plants at wf 1.00 have d_P > 0.03 and within 1e-6 relative of I718-mac/pilot.json's
frozen.P_point_masses: FINDING, not a check: main chord2 and main arc with three equal point masses at REF541[wf][8], [9], [10], phi 0, the share 10^(-3 + j/2) of sigma_22, j 0..9. As a check (j 0..6) it fired in the first run and was replaced by P'
frozen.Pprime: the plant (chord2, radial, L 0.3, P 4, alpha 0, a = b = 1, eta 1, phi 90), built twice at each node with independent noise (pg.noisy, measured errors, seeds 747100 + i and 747200 + i); the reference of order k is copy 1's [k/k] pole nearest to Q; with copy 2 the plant passes (admissible, d_P <= 0.03 at the three nodes) and each of its four lattice neighbours fails; context at eta 1e-2, 1e-1, 10 and the eta = 0 plant
frozen.mutation: control --mutate=shift_poles (the reference poles of J+ and of P' + 0.05): J+ and P''s plant must fail; --mutate=tol (P''s tolerance 3.0): P' must fail; --mutate=noise (copy 2's noise x 1e10): P''s plant must fail; --mutate=len: R4 must fail
frozen.gate: scan runs only if the selftest, J+, J-, P' and R4 pass
